Use one @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@ as a production center, and the other @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@ for research (@building_technology/blacksmith.png@)
After exhausting @resource/berrybush.png@, build new @building_economy/mill.png@ on next berries

Age up to @age/age_3.webp@ with @landmark_byzantines/cistern-of-the-first-hill-2.png@, if against aggro build close to base, if safe you can build near forward @resource/resource_gold.png@ & @resource/berrybush.png@
